note: Known defects found when the baseline was taken (main e1feb25, local build). A waiver keeps the contract green for that exact class of failure only, prints on every run, and must be deleted when the defect is fixed. Anything that does not match a waiver still fails. Never add a waiver to make a new regression pass.

waivers.reason: While there are no synced events, sitemap.xml.ts leaves the events hub out ("Empty hubs stay out of the index") but the page itself is emitted as "index, follow" in a production-context build (BlogPage sets noindex for an empty hub, EventsPage does not). The five empty events hubs are therefore indexable and unlisted, and /wydarzenia 301s to one of them. Fix: noindex the empty events hub, or list it.

BabyLoveGrowth bodies carry a table of contents (a href=#section) but scripts/articles-sync/sanitize.mjs drops every id attribute (ALLOWED h2..h6 = []), so the in-page anchors point nowhere. Fix belongs in the sanitiser or renderer (heading ids), not here.

The terms pages state a Saturday entry fee of 30 zł (src/i18n/legal.ts:42, English text reused for en/de/it/cs) while the reservation copy and llms.txt state 40 zł (src/i18n/ui/pl.ts:327). One of them is wrong; Phase 3 must pick the source of truth.

An article whose title, heading, paragraph or link text holds one unbroken string wider than ~335 px makes the whole page scroll sideways at 375 px (scratch build: scrollWidth 2956; h1, h2, p and a all overflow). src/components/pages/BlogArticlePage.astro sets no overflow-wrap on .ba-title or .ba-body. No published article does this today (82 of 82 sitemap pages measured clean at 375 px), but BabyLoveGrowth citations often use a raw URL as link text. Fix belongs in the article template CSS, not in this contract.
